author: Neema Parvini
body_text:
The antithesis between red ‘East’ and
democratic ‘West’ appears irrelevant

The forms of _ standardisation,
conformism, democratic levelling, frantic
overproduction, the more or less arrogant
cult of the expert (‘brain trust’), and the
petty materialism of Americanism can only
clear the road for the final phase, which
is represented by the Communist ideal
of the mass man. The distinctive trait of
